svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Execution
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-and-risk-preflight; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Decisions Before Execution; subtitle: Proceed only on documented authority, disclosures, access, and risk terms.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: These are sequential pass-or-remediate decisions, not alternative routes around a failed check. State requirements depend on the jurisdiction, product, and activities actually performed.; caption: A failed check pauses the affected activity while the team corrects its scope or evidence. Public account research can continue without accessing employer claim records.; stages: label: Licensed for the activity?; value: Pass to disclosures; otherwise rescope; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify active Life & Health and Property & Casualty producer authority, appointments where required, and applicable TPA or adjuster requirements. California Insurance Code 1631 is one state example; a producer license alone does not authorize every administrative role.; label: Compensation properly disclosed?; value: Pass to access; otherwise correct documents; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For covered arrangements under 29 U.S.C. 1108(b)(2)(B), identify services, direct and indirect compensation, payers, and payment methods; furnish required disclosures reasonably before execution, extension, or renewal. Reconcile PBM and carrier payments with employer-facing terms.; label: Claims access properly controlled?; value: Pass to terms; otherwise restrict processing; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Apply 45 CFR 164.502(b) minimum-necessary requirements where applicable, 164.504(e) business-associate arrangements, and 164.308 security safeguards. Verify plan-sponsor access conditions and role separation rather than treating employer ownership as unrestricted permission to inspect health records.; label: Coverage and corrections supportable?; value: Proceed with evidence; otherwise redesign scope; numeric value: 4.0; detail: For ERISA fiduciary decisions, document the prudent process under 29 U.S.C. 1104. Test lasers, attachment points, run-out, exclusions, and balance-bill defense. For E-Mod work, use the applicable bureau rules, correction deadlines, and supported payroll and loss evidence.

rect.title: label: Licensed for the activity?; value: Pass to disclosures; otherwise rescope; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Verify active Life & Health and Property & Casualty producer authority, appointments where required, and applicable TPA or adjuster requirements. California Insurance Code 1631 is one state example; a producer license alone does not authorize every administrative role.

text.title: Verify active Life & Health and Property & Casualty producer authority, appointments where required, and applicable TPA or adjuster requirements. California Insurance Code 1631 is one state example; a producer license alone does not authorize every administrative role.

rect.title: label: Compensation properly disclosed?; value: Pass to access; otherwise correct documents; numeric value: 2.0; detail: For covered arrangements under 29 U.S.C. 1108(b)(2)(B), identify services, direct and indirect compensation, payers, and payment methods; furnish required disclosures reasonably before execution, extension, or renewal. Reconcile PBM and carrier payments with employer-facing terms.

text.title: For covered arrangements under 29 U.S.C. 1108(b)(2)(B), identify services, direct and indirect compensation, payers, and payment methods; furnish required disclosures reasonably before execution, extension, or renewal. Reconcile PBM and carrier payments with employer-facing terms.

rect.title: label: Claims access properly controlled?; value: Pass to terms; otherwise restrict processing; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Apply 45 CFR 164.502(b) minimum-necessary requirements where applicable, 164.504(e) business-associate arrangements, and 164.308 security safeguards. Verify plan-sponsor access conditions and role separation rather than treating employer ownership as unrestricted permission to inspect health records.

Test lasers, attachment points, run-out, exclusions, and balance-bill defense. For E-Mod work, use the applicable bureau rules, correction deadlines, and supported payroll and loss evidence.

text.title: For ERISA fiduciary decisions, document the prudent process under 29 U.S.C. 1104. Test lasers, attachment points, run-out, exclusions, and balance-bill defense. For E-Mod work, use the applicable bureau rules, correction deadlines, and supported payroll and loss evidence.
Assumptions: These are sequential pass-or-remediate decisions, not alternative routes around a failed check. State requirements depend on the jurisdiction, product, and activities actually performed.
